classification: Conditional public affordability helper overflow contract; inspected rent-offer producer uses bounded u32 costs.
trace: best_affordable_house promises to retain one recurring payment and filters using initial_cost.saturating_add(recurring_cost.saturating_mul(1)) <= available. A constructed offer with initial_cost=u64::MAX, recurring_cost=1 and available=u64::MAX passes the saturated comparison, although its mathematical sum exceeds available. The helper does not debit funds and no execution was performed.

The inspected residence producer converts a u32 rent_per_period into both initial and recurring u64 costs. Their sum is at most 2*(2^32-1), well below u64::MAX, so this producer cannot trigger that particular overflow. Other helper callers, stored offer construction and supported financial limits remain open.

Selection ordering and reserve policy are distinct from strategic money ownership. Do not assert that an NPC actually rents without a reserve or that saturated extreme inputs are admitted by the current producer.
repair_direction: Trace all offer constructors and intentional cost limits. If separately authorized, make the reserve comparison correct for the chosen input domain while preserving valid affordability, ranking, tie-breaking and economic semantics.
later_acceptance: After separate repair authorization, verify exactly affordable, insufficient, zero, maximum and overflow-cost offers, as well as normal u32-rent producer behavior.
remaining: Establish supported extreme-input reachability and all connected history; no product build, test, database or runtime probe was performed.
discovery_status: partial; source-level constructed input, current shown producer bounded
